title: Adding a New Module
text: dittoViz functions: use dittoViz_<PlotName> (e.g., dittoViz_scatterPlot dittoViz::scatterPlot) plotthis functions: use plotthis_<PlotName> (e.g., plotthis_AreaPlot plotthis::AreaPlot) custom/standalone functions: use plot name directly (e.g., linePlot, piePlot) adding brand-new plotting function (e.g., piePlot), define document plot function first, wrap module. Create three core files: R/<moduleName>_module_ui.R, R/<moduleName>_module_server.R, R/<moduleName>_module_app.R. Document UI, server, app functions roxygen (@export, params, examples). @section Plot parameters implemented altered functionality: - List inputs exposed @section Plot parameters defaults: - Document exposed parameters UI labels defaults @section Plot parameters implementing new functionality: - Document new plotly-specific controls (axes, ticks, reference lines, etc) Add example app uses module twice prove multi-instance behavior. Cover base plotting function testthat; cover module/app shinytest2. Note ggplotly conversion quirks change drop functionality. Never use eval(str2expression()) raw user input. Use safe_eval_filter(), validate_expression(), safe_resolve_adj_fxn() instead (see Sanitizing User-Provided Expressions ).

title: Building Custom Modules
text: building custom module, need handle Shiny’s namespacing correctly. key insight : module’s custom inputs need namespaced NS(id). base module’s UI server functions receive bare id, namespaced version. Data processing requires access module’s inputs must happen inside moduleServer() block. base module’s server called outside moduleServer() block avoid double-namespacing issues.

title: Building Custom Modules
text: Let’s build custom module adds simple filtering checkbox scatterPlot module.

title: Building Custom Modules
text: Notice checkboxInput() uses ns("filter_setosa") namespace custom input, dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI() receives bare id. ensures base module creates inputs correct namespace.
code: library(VizModules)  minimalModuleUI <- function(id) {     ns <- NS(id)     tagList(         h4("Minimal Module Controls"),         # Custom input - uses the module's namespace         checkboxInput(ns("filter_setosa"), "Start with Setosa Only", value = FALSE),         hr(),         # Base module UI - pass the bare 'id', not ns(id)         dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI(id, iris)     ) }  minimalModuleOutput <- function(id) {     # Simply delegate to the base module's output UI     dittoViz_scatterPlotOutputUI(id) }

title: Building Custom Modules
text: pattern? moduleServer(id, ...) gives us access input$filter_setosa, namespaced wrapper’s id. calling dittoViz_scatterPlotServer(id, filtered_data) outside moduleServer() closure, base module attaches namespace UI, nested one. called dittoViz_scatterPlotServer() inside moduleServer() block, create nested namespaces like id-id-x_axis, wouldn’t match actual input IDs UI.
code: minimalModuleServer <- function(id, data_reactive) {     # Step 1: Process data inside a moduleServer block     # This gives us access to inputs namespaced to 'id' (our module's inputs)     filtered_data <- moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {         reactive({             req(data_reactive())             df <- data_reactive()              # Input specific to this custom module             if (isTRUE(input$filter_setosa)) {                 if ("Species" %in% names(df)) {                     df <- df[df$Species == "setosa", ]                 }             }             df         })     })      # Step 2: Call the base module server OUTSIDE the moduleServer block     # This is critical! If we called this inside the moduleServer above,     # dittoViz_scatterPlotServer would look for inputs at id-id-inputName instead of id-inputName     dittoViz_scatterPlotServer(id, filtered_data) }

title: Building Custom Modules
code: ui <- fluidPage(     titlePanel("Minimal Module Example"),     sidebarLayout(         sidebarPanel(             minimalModuleUI("demo")         ),         mainPanel(             minimalModuleOutput("demo")         )     ) )  server <- function(input, output, session) {     # Pass a reactive data source to the module     minimalModuleServer("demo", reactive({         iris     })) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Quick Start with VizModules
text: modules follow pattern: *InputsUI() controls, *OutputUI() plot, *Server() logic. minimal scatterPlot example:
code: library(VizModules)  ui <- fluidPage(     sidebarLayout(         sidebarPanel(             dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI("cars",                 mtcars,                 defaults = list(                     x.by = "wt",                     y.by = "mpg",                     color.by = "cyl"                 )             )         ),         mainPanel(dittoViz_scatterPlotOutputUI("cars"))     ) )  server <- function(input, output, session) {     dittoViz_scatterPlotServer("cars", data = reactive(mtcars)) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Quick Start with VizModules
text: Defaults: Pass named list defaults argument *InputsUI() pre-fill inputs. Names match underlying plot function arguments (e.g., defaults = list(fill.color = "steelblue")). Hide inputs: Use hide.inputs server call remove controls still initializing values. useful app sets certain parameters . Hide tabs: Use hide.tabs remove whole groups controls (e.g., "Plotly" "Legend" scatterPlot). Hidden inputs tabs still feed values plot, module stays fully configured exposing users need.
code: dittoViz_scatterPlotServer(     "cars",     data = reactive(mtcars),     hide.inputs = c("split.by", "rows.use"),     hide.tabs = c("Plotly") )

title: Quick Start with VizModules
text: provide collect_source_data() assemble compact record plotted data, stats, UI inputs, rendered plot, create_source_download_handler() turn record downloadable .zip. collect_source_data() requires reactive plotly plot; output summary can optionally enriched stats reactive UI inputs reactive. create_source_download_handler() also accepts named list summaries (one per plot), Panel Builder bundles every plot canvas single download.
code: if (interactive()) {     library(shiny)     library(plotly)      ui <- fluidPage(         plotlyOutput("plot"),         downloadButton("download_summary", "Download Summary")     )      server <- function(input, output, session) {         # A reactive plotly plot         plot_reactive <- reactive({             plot_ly(mtcars, x = ~wt, y = ~mpg, type = "scatter", mode = "markers")         })          # Optional: a reactive returning a stats data.frame         stats_reactive <- reactive({             data.frame(                 metric = c("mean_mpg", "sd_mpg"),                 value  = c(mean(mtcars$mpg), sd(mtcars$mpg))             )         })          # Optional: capture all UI inputs as a named list         AllInputs <- reactive({             reactiveValuesToList(input)         })          output$plot <- renderPlotly(plot_reactive())          # Assemble the summary, then wire up the download handler.         plot_summary_reactive <- reactive({             collect_source_data(                 plot_reactive   = plot_reactive,                 stats_reactive  = stats_reactive,                 inputs_reactive = AllInputs()             )         })          output$download_summary <- create_source_download_handler(             data_list     = plot_summary_reactive,             filename_base = "my_plot_summary"         )     }      shinyApp(ui, server) }

what: Plot parameters not implemented or with altered functionality
title: Input UI components for the scatterPlot module — dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI
text: following dittoViz::scatterPlot() parameters available via UI inputs superseded: xlab - X-axis label (auto-generated reflect applied X adjustment, e.g. "log2(z-score(units))"; plotly allows interactive editing) ylab - Y-axis label (auto-generated reflect applied Y adjustment, e.g. "log2(z-score(units))"; plotly allows interactive editing) main - Plot title (plotly allows interactive editing) sub - Plot subtitle (supported plotly) theme - ggplot2 theme (applicable plotly) legend.title - Legend title (managed plotly interactively) legend.color.size - Legend color size (supported plotly) legend.shape.size - Legend shape size (supported plotly) add.xline - Use vline.intercepts instead vertical lines full styling options add.yline - Use hline.intercepts instead horizontal lines full styling options xline.linetype - Use vline.linetypes instead xline.color - Use vline.colors instead yline.linetype - Use hline.linetypes instead yline.color - Use hline.colors instead .letter - Lettering subplots (implemented plotly) .label - Labeling points interactively (compatible plotly hover) new Lines tab provides enhanced functionality including multiple lines per type, individual line widths, opacities, diagonal/ablines slope control.

text: following dittoViz::yPlot() parameters available via UI inputs: xlab - X-axis label (plotly allows interactive editing) ylab - Y-axis label (auto-generated reflect applied Y adjustment, e.g. "log2(z-score(units))"; plotly allows interactive editing) main - Plot title (plotly allows interactive editing) sub - Plot subtitle (supported plotly) theme - ggplot2 theme (applicable plotly) legend.title - Legend title (managed plotly interactively) add.line - Use hline.intercepts instead horizontal lines full styling options line.linetype - Use hline.linetypes instead line.color - Use hline.colors instead

text: following dittoViz::yPlot() parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: var - Y-axis variable (UI: "Y data (var)", default: 2nd numeric variable) group.- Grouping variable x-axis (UI: "Group ", default: 2nd categorical variable) color.- Coloring variable (UI: "Color ", default: "") shape.- Shape variable (UI: "Shape ", default: "") split.- Faceting variable (UI: "Split (facet)", default: "") plots - Plot types show (UI: "Plots show", default: c("boxplot", "jitter")) color.panel - Custom color values (UI: palette picker, derived palette) min - Y-axis minimum (UI: "Y Axis Min", auto-calculated) max - Y-axis maximum (UI: "Y Axis Max", auto-calculated) var.adjustment - Y-axis data adjustment (UI: "Y Adjustment", default: "") var.adj.fxn - Y-axis adjustment function (UI: "Y Adjustment Function", default: "") split.nrow - Number facet rows (UI: "Rows", default: 4) split.ncol - Number facet columns (UI: "Columns", default: 4) split.adjust - Facet scale behavior (UI: "Facet Scaling", default: "free") .raster - Rasterize jitter points (UI: "Rasterize Jitter", default: FALSE) raster.dpi - DPI rasterization (UI: "Raster DPI", default: 600) jitter.size - Jitter point size (UI: "Jitter Point Size", default: 1) jitter.width - Jitter width (UI: "Jitter Width", default: 0.2) jitter.color - Jitter point color (UI: "Jitter Point Color", default: "#000000") jitter.shape.legend.size - text: Generates customizable interactive dumbbell plot using plotly. Supports single dot mode (1 x variable) dumbbell mode (2 x variables), flexible coloring either X Y variables, faceting, transformations.

title: Create an Interactive Dumbbell Plot with plotly — dumbbellPlot
code: dumbbellPlot(   data,   x,   y,   colour.by = "X variables",   palette.selection,   show.legend = TRUE,   facet.by = NULL,   line.colour = "gray80",   facet.scales = "fixed",   subplot.margin = 0.05,   axis.showline = TRUE,   axis.mirror = TRUE,   axis.linecolor = "black",   axis.linewidth = 0.5,   axis.tickfont.size = 12,   axis.tickfont.color = "black",   axis.tickfont.family = "Arial",   axis.tickangle.x = 0,   axis.tickangle.y = 0,   axis.ticks = "outside",   axis.tickcolor = "black",   axis.ticklen = 5,   axis.tickwidth = 1,   title.text = "",   title.font.size = 26,   title.font.family = "Arial",   title.font.color = "black",   title.x.position = 0.47,   y.title = NULL,   x.title = NULL,   flip.x = FALSE,   flip.y = FALSE,   x.adjustment = NULL,   order.by = NULL )

title: Create an Interactive Dumbbell Plot with plotly — dumbbellPlot
text: data data.frame tibble containing data plot. x Character vector column name(s) x-axis values. Maximum 2 values allowed. 1 value: creates single dot plot. 2 values: creates dumbbell plot connecting segments. y Character, column name y-axis (categorical variable recommended). colour.Character, color markers. Options: "X variables" (different colors x variable) "Y variables" (different colors y category). Default: "X variables". palette.selection Character vector hex colors marker colors. show.legend Logical, whether display legend. Default: TRUE. facet.Optional character, column name facet plots . Creates subplots unique value. Default: NULL. line.colour Character, hex color connecting lines dumbbell points. Default: "gray80". facet.scales Character, controls axis scaling across facets. Options: "fixed" (), "free" (independent), "free_x" (independent x-axis), "free_y" (independent y-axis). Default: "fixed". subplot.margin Numeric, spacing facet panels fraction plot area. May single value (applied directions) length-2 vector c(horizontal, vertical) control gap columns rows separately. Default: 0.06. axis.showline Logical, whether show axis border lines. Default: TRUE. axis.mirror Logical, whether mirror axis lines opposite side plot. Default: TRUE. axis.linecolor Character, hex color axis lines. Default: "black". axis.linewidth Numeric, width axis lines pixels. Default: 0.5. axis.tickfont.size Numeric, font size axis tick labels. Default: 12. axis.tickfont.color Character, hex color axis tick labels. Default: "black". axis.tickfont.family Character, font family axis tick labels. Default: "Arial". axis.tickangle.x Numeric, rotation angle x-axis tick labels degrees. Default: 0. axis.tickangle.y Numeric, rotation angle y-axis tick labels degrees. Default: 0. axis.ticks Character, position tick marks. Options: "outside", "inside", "none". Default: "outside". axis.tickcolor Character, hex color tick marks. Default: "black". axis.ticklen Numeric, length tick marks pixels. Default: 5. axis.tickwidth Numeric, width tick marks pixels. Default: 1. title.text Character, main title text plot. Default: "". title.font.size Numeric, font size plot title. Default: 26. title.font.family Character, font family plot title. Default: "Arial". title.font.color Character, hex color plot title text. Default: "black". title.x.position Numeric, horizontal position plot title paper coordinates (0 = left, 1 = right). Default: 0.47. y.title Optional character, label y-axis. NULL, auto-generated column name. Default: NULL. x.title Optional character, label x-axis. NULL, auto-generated column name. Default: NULL. flip.x Logical, whether reverse x-axis direction. Default: FALSE. flip.y Logical, whether reverse y-axis direction. Default: FALSE. x.adjustment Optional character function, transformation apply x values. Options: "log2", "log", "log10", "neg_log10", "log1p", ".factor", "abs", "sqrt", custom function. Default: NULL. order.Optional character vector, column name(s) order data plotting. Default: NULL.

title: Create an Interactive Dumbbell Plot with plotly — dumbbellPlot
text: plotly object representing interactive dumbbell plot.

title: Create an Interactive Dumbbell Plot with plotly — dumbbellPlot
text: dumbbell plot designed comparing two values across categories. Modes: Single dot mode (1 x variable): Shows one marker per y category Dumbbell mode (2 x variables): Shows two markers connected line per y category Coloring options: X variables: x variable gets different color (e.g., Male=blue, Female=pink) Y variables: y category gets different color (e.g., School =red, School B=blue)

title: Create an Interactive Dumbbell Plot with plotly — dumbbellPlot
text: Jacob Martin

title: Create an Interactive Dumbbell Plot with plotly — dumbbellPlot
code: data <- data.frame(     School = c("MIT", "Stanford", "Harvard"),     Women = c(152, 96, 112),     Men = c(95, 151, 165) )  fig <- dumbbellPlot(     data = data,     x = c("Women", "Men"),     y = "School",     colour.by = "X variables",     palette.selection = c("green", "blue"),     show.legend = TRUE,     line.colour = "gray80" )

Marker genes strongly expressed canonical cell type; Disease replicates include simulated ~1.2 log2FC upregulation marker genes, making biological comparisons visually informative.

title: Create an Interactive Line Plot with plotly — linePlot
text: data data.frame tibble containing data plot. x Character vector column name(s) x-axis. Multiple columns create separate traces. y Character vector column name(s) y-axis. Multiple columns create separate traces. palette.selection Character vector hex colors line colors. Used assign colors groups traces. plot.mode Character, plotly mode plot type. Options: "lines", "markers", "lines+markers". Default: "lines". line.type Character, line style. Options: "solid", "dot", "dash", "longdash", "dashdot", "longdashdot". Default: "solid". colour.group.Character formula, column name(s) group lines color. Can formula like ~ column_name. Ignored multiple x y columns provided. Default: NULL. show.legend Logical, whether display legend. Default: TRUE. facet.Optional character, column name facet plots . Creates subplots unique value. Default: NULL. facet.scales Character, controls axis scaling across facets. Options: "fixed" (), "free" (independent), "free_x" (independent x-axis), "free_y" (independent y-axis). Default: "fixed". facet.nrow Optional integer, number rows faceted subplot grid. NULL (default), single row used unless facet.ncol supplied, case number rows derived number facet levels. facet.ncol Optional integer, number columns faceted subplot grid. NULL (default), columns derived facet.nrow number facet levels. one facet.nrow / facet.ncol needs set; provided, facet.nrow takes precedence. subplot.margin Numeric, spacing facet panels fraction plot area. May single value (applied directions) length-2 vector c(horizontal, vertical) control gap columns rows separately. Default: 0.05. axis.showline Logical, whether show axis border lines. Default: TRUE. axis.mirror Logical, whether mirror axis lines opposite side plot. Default: TRUE. axis.linecolor Character, hex color axis lines. Default: "black". axis.linewidth Numeric, width axis lines pixels. Default: 0.5. axis.tickfont.size Numeric, font size axis tick labels. Default: 12. axis.tickfont.color Character, hex color axis tick labels. Default: "black". axis.tickfont.family Character, font family axis tick labels. Default: "Arial". axis.tickangle.x Numeric, rotation angle x-axis tick labels degrees. Default: 0. axis.tickangle.y Numeric, rotation angle y-axis tick labels degrees. Default: 0. axis.ticks Character, position tick marks. Options: "outside", "inside", "none". Default: "outside". axis.tickcolor Character, hex color tick marks. Default: "black". axis.ticklen Numeric, length tick marks pixels. Default: 5. axis.tickwidth Numeric, width tick marks pixels. Default: 1. show.grid.x Logical, whether show gridlines x-axis. Default: TRUE. show.grid.y Logical, whether show gridlines y-axis. Default: TRUE. title.text Character, main title text plot. Default: "". title.font.size Numeric, font size plot title. Default: 14. title.font.family Character, font family plot title. Default: "Arial". title.font.color Character, hex color plot title text. Default: "black". title.x.position Numeric, horizontal position plot title paper coordinates (0 = left, 1 = right). Default: 0.47. y.title Optional character, label y-axis. NULL, auto-generated column name. x single categorical column, plotted y-values per-group means, title wrapped mean(<y.title>) accurately describe summary displayed. Default: NULL. x.title Optional character, label x-axis. NULL, auto-generated column name. Default: NULL. flip.x Logical, whether reverse x-axis direction. Default: FALSE. flip.y Logical, whether reverse y-axis direction. Default: FALSE. x.adjustment Optional character function, transformation apply x values. Options: "log2", "log", "log10", "neg_log10", "log1p", ".factor", "abs", "sqrt", custom function. Default: NULL. y.adjustment Optional character function, transformation apply y values. Options: "log2", "log", "log10", "neg_log10", "log1p", ".factor", "abs", "sqrt", custom function. Default: NULL. color.adjustment Optional character function, transformation apply color grouping variable. options x.adjustment y.adjustment. Default: NULL. order.Optional character vector, column name(s) order data plotting. Default: NULL. error.colour hex colour input set colour error bars plot categorical X axis 1 Y axis variable error.width numeric input set width error bars plot categorical X axis 1 Y axis variable error.bar Boolean value determine error bars plot categorical X axis 1 Y axis variable

text: following linePlot() parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: x - X-axis variable(s) (UI: "Select X values", defaults key: x.value, default: 1st column, multiple: TRUE) y - Y-axis variable(s) (UI: "Select Y values", defaults key: y.value, default: 2nd column, multiple: TRUE) title.font.size - Plot title font size (UI: "Title Size", default: 26) title.font.family - Font family title text (UI: "Title Font", default: "Arial") title.font.color - Color plot title (UI: "Title Color", default: "#000000") axis.title.font.size - Axis title font size (UI: "Axis Title Size", default: 18) axis.title.font.color - Axis title font color (UI: "Axis Title Color", default: "#000000") axis.title.font.family - Axis title font family (UI: "Axis Title Font", default: "Arial") group.- Grouping variable (UI: "Group ", default: 1st categorical variable) order.- Order Y values (UI: "Order Y", default: FALSE) x.adjustment - X-axis adjustment function (UI: "X Adjustment", default: "") y.adjustment - Y-axis adjustment function (UI: "Y Adjustment", default: "") facet.- Faceting variable (UI: "Facet ", default: "") facet.scales - Facet scale behavior (UI: "Facet scales", default: "fixed") facet.nrow - Number rows facet grid (UI: "Rows", default: NULL; blank = auto) facet.ncol - Number columns facet grid (UI: "Columns", default: NULL; blank = auto) plot.mode - Plot type (UI: "Plot type", default: "lines") line.type - Line type (UI: "Line type", default: "solid") palette.selection - Color palette (UI: palette picker, derived palette) axis.showline - Show axis border lines (UI: "Show Axis Borders", default: TRUE) axis.mirror - Mirror axis lines opposite side (UI: "Mirror Axis Borders", default: TRUE) axis.linecolor - Color axis lines (UI: "Axis Line Color", default: "black") axis.linewidth - Width axis lines (UI: "Axis Line Width", default: 0.5) axis.tickfont.size - Size tick labels (UI: "Tick Label Size", default: 12) axis.tickfont.color - Color tick labels (UI: "Tick Label Color", default: "black") axis.tickfont.family - Font family tick labels (UI: "Tick Label Font", default: "Arial") axis.tickangle.x - Rotation angle X-axis tick labels (UI: "X Tick Label Angle", default: 0) axis.tickangle.y - Rotation angle Y-axis tick labels (UI: "Y Tick Label Angle", default: 0) axis.ticks - Position tick marks (UI: "Tick Position", default: "outside") axis.tickcolor - Color tick marks (UI: "Tick Mark Color", default: "black") axis.ticklen - Length tick marks (UI: "Tick Mark Length", default: 5) axis.tickwidth - Width tick marks (UI: "Tick Mark Width", default: 1) facet.title.font.size - Facet subplot title font size (UI: "Facet Subplot Title Size", default: 18) facet.title.font.color - Facet subplot title font color (UI: "Facet Title Color", default: "#000000") facet.title.font.family - Facet subplot title font family (UI: "Facet Title Font", default: "Arial") show.grid.x - Show X-axis gridlines (UI: "Show X Gridlines", default: TRUE) show.grid.y - Show Y-axis gridlines (UI: "Show Y Gridlines", default: TRUE) grid.color - Gridline color (UI: "Gridline Color", default: "#CCCCCC") x.title - X-axis title (auto-calculated data) y.title - Y-axis title (auto-calculated data) flip.x - Flip X-axis (UI: "Flip X", default: FALSE) flip.y - title: Input UI components for the SplitBarPlot module — plotthis_SplitBarPlotInputsUI
text: following plotthis::SplitBarPlot() parameters available via UI inputs: xlab - X-axis label (plotly allows interactive editing) ylab - Y-axis label (plotly allows interactive editing) title - Plot title (plotly allows interactive editing) subtitle - Plot subtitle (supported plotly) aspect.ratio - Aspect ratio control (handled plotly layout) legend.position - Legend positioning (plotly allows interactive repositioning) y_sep - Separator y columns (applicable UI context) flip - Flip axes (implemented current UI) split_by_sep - Separator split columns (applicable UI context) order_y - Y-axis ordering rules (handled default logic) lineheight - Text line height (applicable plotly) max_charwidth - Maximum character width (applicable plotly) fill_by_sep - Separator fill columns (applicable UI context) fill_name - Fill legend name (handled plotly) direction_pos_name - Positive direction name (implemented) direction_neg_name - Negative direction name (implemented) theme - ggplot2 theme (applicable plotly) theme_args - Theme arguments (applicable plotly) palette - Managed internally via palette selection UI keep_empty - Keep empty values (implemented) keep_na - Keep NA values (implemented) combine - applies split_by used nrow - applies split_by used ncol - applies split_by used byrow - applies split_by used seed - Random seed (applicable) axes - applies split_by used axis_titles - applies split_by used guides - applies split_by used design - applies split_by used legend_direction - Managed position legend however can handled via plotly

text: df data frame containing data plot. single trace, provide columns categories (theta) values (r). multiple traces, include grouping column. function automatically closes radar polygon adding first point end. theta Character, name column use angular categories (axes). r Character, name column use radial values. group Optional character, name column use grouping multiple traces. NULL, single trace plotted. Default: NULL. colors Optional character vector hex colors traces. named, values matched group values; otherwise colours recycled. palette Optional character vector fallback colors used colors supplied missing values present. fill Logical character, whether fill area trace. Use "toself" fill first point, FALSE fill. Default: "toself". line.width Numeric, width trace lines pixels. Default: 2. line.dash Character, line dash style. Options: "solid", "dot", "dash", "longdash", "dashdot", "longdashdot". Default: "solid". marker.size Numeric, size markers trace. Default: 5. marker.symbol Character, marker symbol. Options: "circle", "square", "diamond", "cross", "x", "triangle-", etc. Default: "circle". opacity Numeric, opacity traces (0-1). Default: 0.6. radial.visible Logical, whether show radial axis. Default: TRUE. radial.range Optional numeric vector length 2 specifying range radial axis (e.g., c(0, 100)). NULL, automatically determined. Default: NULL. radial.showline Logical, whether show radial axis line. Default: TRUE. radial.linecolor Character, hex color radial axis line. Default: "#444444". radial.gridcolor Character, hex color radial grid lines. Default: "#EEEEEE". angular.direction Character, direction angular axis. Options: "clockwise" "counterclockwise". Default: "clockwise". angular.rotation Numeric, rotation angle angular axis degrees. Default: 90. angular.gridcolor Character, hex color angular grid lines. Default: "#EEEEEE". show.legend Logical, whether display legend. Default: TRUE. legend.orientation Character, legend orientation. Options: "h" (horizontal) "v" (vertical). Default: "h". legend.x Numeric, horizontal legend position offset (0-1). Default: 0.5. legend.y Numeric, vertical legend position offset (-1 1). Default: -0.1. legend.font.family Character, font family legend text. Default: "Arial". legend.font.size Numeric, font size legend text. Default: 12. legend.font.color Character, hex color legend text. Default: "#000000". title.text Character, main plot title text. Default: "". title.font.family Character, font family title text. Default: "Arial". title.font.size Numeric, font size title text. Default: 18. title.font.color Character, hex color title text. Default: "#000000". title.x Numeric, horizontal position plot title (0-1). Default: 0.5. bgcolor Character, hex color plot background. Default: "#FFFFFF". polar.bgcolor Character, hex color polar area background. Default: "#FFFFFF".

title: Set up auto-update/isolate logic for reactive contexts — setup_auto_update_logic
code: if (interactive()) {     library(shiny)     library(plotly)      ui <- fluidPage(         selectInput("x_var", "X variable", choices = names(mtcars), selected = "wt"),         selectInput("y_var", "Y variable", choices = names(mtcars), selected = "mpg"),         checkboxInput("auto.update", "Auto-update", value = TRUE),         actionButton("update", "Update"),         plotlyOutput("myPlot")     )      server <- function(input, output, session) {         output$myPlot <- renderPlotly({             isolate_fn <- setup_auto_update_logic(input)             x_val <- isolate_fn(input$x_var)             y_val <- isolate_fn(input$y_var)             plot_ly(mtcars, x = ~ .data[[x_val]], y = ~ .data[[y_val]], type = "scatter",                 mode = "markers")         })     }      shinyApp(ui, server) }

title: Create a plotly ternary plot — ternaryPlot
text: df data frame containing data plot. Must contain numeric columns three ternary axes (, b, c). multiple traces, include grouping column. Character, name column use -axis (top vertex). b Character, name column use b-axis (bottom-left vertex). c Character, name column use c-axis (bottom-right vertex). group Optional character, name column use grouping multiple traces. NULL, single trace plotted. Default: NULL. colors Optional character vector hex colors traces. named, values matched group values; otherwise colours recycled. palette Optional character vector fallback colors used colors supplied missing values present. sum Numeric, constant sum ternary axes (e.g., 100 percentages, 1 proportions). data points sum value. Default: 100. mode Character, trace mode. Options: "markers", "lines", "lines+markers". Default: "markers". marker.size Numeric, size markers trace. Default: 8. marker.symbol Character, marker symbol. Options: "circle", "square", "diamond", "cross", "x", "triangle-", etc. Default: "circle". marker.line.width Numeric, width marker border line. Default: 0. marker.line.color Character, hex color marker border. Default: "#000000". line.width Numeric, width trace lines pixels (used mode includes "lines"). Default: 2. line.dash Character, line dash style. Options: "solid", "dot", "dash", "longdash", "dashdot", "longdashdot". Default: "solid". opacity Numeric, opacity traces (0-1). Default: 1. .title Character, title -axis. Default: "". b.title Character, title b-axis. Default: "b". c.title Character, title c-axis. Default: "c". .titlefont.size Numeric, font size -axis title. Default: 16. b.titlefont.size Numeric, font size b-axis title. Default: 16. c.titlefont.size Numeric, font size c-axis title. Default: 16. .titlefont.family Character, font family -axis title. Default: "Arial". b.titlefont.family Character, font family b-axis title. Default: "Arial". c.titlefont.family Character, font family c-axis title. Default: "Arial". .titlefont.color Character, hex color -axis title. Default: "#000000". b.titlefont.color Character, hex color b-axis title. Default: "#000000". c.titlefont.color Character, hex color c-axis title. Default: "#000000". .tickfont.size Numeric, font size -axis tick labels. Default: 12. b.tickfont.size Numeric, font size b-axis tick labels. Default: 12. c.tickfont.size Numeric, font size c-axis tick labels. Default: 12. .tickcolor Character, hex color -axis ticks. Default: "rgba(0,0,0,0)". b.tickcolor Character, hex color b-axis ticks. Default: "rgba(0,0,0,0)". c.tickcolor Character, hex color c-axis ticks. Default: "rgba(0,0,0,0)". .ticklen Numeric, length -axis ticks. Default: 5. b.ticklen Numeric, length b-axis ticks. Default: 5. c.ticklen Numeric, length c-axis ticks. Default: 5. .gridcolor Character, hex color -axis gridlines. Default: "#EEEEEE". b.gridcolor Character, hex color b-axis gridlines. Default: "#EEEEEE". c.gridcolor Character, hex color c-axis gridlines. Default: "#EEEEEE". show.legend Logical, whether display legend. Default: TRUE. legend.orientation Character, legend orientation. Options: "h" (horizontal) "v" (vertical). Default: "h". legend.x Numeric, horizontal legend position offset (0-1). Default: 0.5. legend.y Numeric, vertical legend position offset (-1 1). Default: -0.1. legend.font.family Character, font family legend text. Default: "Arial". legend.font.size Numeric, font size legend text. Default: 12. legend.font.color Character, hex color legend text. Default: "#000000". title.text Character, main plot title text. Default: "". title.font.family Character, font family title text. Default: "Arial". title.font.size Numeric, font size title text. Default: 18. title.font.color Character, hex color title text. Default: "#000000". title.x Numeric, horizontal position plot title (0-1). Default: 0.5. bgcolor Character, hex color plot background. Default: "#FFFFFF".

code: if (interactive()) {     library(shiny)     groups <- c("setosa", "virginica", "versicolor")      ui <- fluidPage(         multiColorPicker(             "species_cols",             "Species colors",             groups = groups,             selected_palette = "dittoColors"         ),         actionButton("randomize", "Randomize colors"),         actionButton("apply_pal", "Apply ggplot2 palette"),         actionButton("reset_cols", "Reset to initial"),         verbatimTextOutput("chosen")     )      server <- function(input, output, session) {         output$chosen <- renderPrint(input$species_cols)          observeEvent(input$randomize, {             new_colors <- setNames(                 sprintf("#%06X", sample(0xFFFFFF, length(groups))),                 groups             )             updateMultiColorPicker(session, "species_cols", colors = new_colors)         })          observeEvent(input$apply_pal, {             updateMultiColorPicker(session, "species_cols", palette = "ggplot2")         })          observeEvent(input$reset_cols, {             updateMultiColorPicker(session, "species_cols", reset = TRUE)         })     }      shinyApp(ui, server) }

title: VizModules 0.2.0
text: Created Figure Builder app users can dynamically construct multi-panel figures using different data sets plot types single page. Allows full page SVG export, source data dump organized per panel, full customization plot position size. *OutputUI() functions gained resizable argument (default TRUE). FALSE, plot output longer wrapped shinyjqui::jqui_resizable(), avoids redundant resize handle output embedded container already provides resizing (Figure Builder app cards). Added new plotthis_DotPlot module (plotthis_DotPlotInputsUI(), plotthis_DotPlotOutputUI(), plotthis_DotPlotServer(), plotthis_DotPlotApp() convenience wrapper) wraps plotthis::DotPlot() interactive dot plots, including custom dot-size legend since plotly still lacks capability. Added example_markers dataset, simulated single-cell marker-gene expression table (immune cell types × marker genes) used default example data DotPlot module. Added “Source Data” download button bottom every module’s control panel. button creates downloads ZIP file containing self-contained HTML plotly plot, CSV plot data (retrieved via plotly::plotly_data()), modules statistics enabled (Box / Violin / yPlot), table statistics info. Source downloads now built exported collect_source_data() create_source_download_handler() helpers, module server returns source reactive can reused (e.g. Figure Builder). Given source data now required many journals, important. Removed old interactive plot download button associated helper function. Removed old dynamically hidden stats download button associated logic, since stats now included source download applicable. Statistic helper functions now exported allowing users annotate plotly graphs custom statistics: compute_pairwise_stats(), create_stat_annotations(), apply_stat_annotations(), generate_pair_strings(), parse_pair_strings(). Exposed empty_plot() use placeholder, e.g. parameters aren’t valid given plot type, pass info user without ugly error messages. Faceting improvements - new internal helpers control subplot spacing, subplot size, facet_scale handling. fixes much wonkiness plots many panels. Uniform inputs added panel spacing across modules. Axis titles now uniformly added annotations allow interactive repositioning. Condensed package wide workflows simple helpers, e.g. .apply_title_layout(), resulting significantly less jank. Axis adjustments now properly reflected axis/legend titles appropriate modules, e.g. yPlot, scatterPlot, linePlot. Removed handful spurious/non-functional inputs, particularly dittoViz_scatterPlot module. Custom size.legends added plotthis_DotPlot dittoViz_scatterPlot modules, since plotly yet support .
